# Context

State the background in one paragraph. Name the problem or the
opportunity, and say why the decision matters now.

# Decision drivers

List the things that constrain or shape the decision. Include
timescales, cost limits, risk appetite, and any policy or legal
requirements.

# Considered options

Describe the options the decision makers weighed. One paragraph per
option works well:

**Option A.** The favoured option and the reasons it fits.

**Option B.** The alternative and why it falls short.

# Decision outcome

State the chosen option in one sentence, then say who approved it and
when. Record any conditions on the decision.

# Consequences

Record the expected consequences. Name what must happen next, who
owns it, and when it falls due.
